> Some initial comments. In general, this PR can be reduced quite a bit, simply but not reverting all the work that has been done on the core to reduce the LOC in general.

Yepp, developing the integration in a separate repo and then back-port was not the best idea I had, I won't do it this way again 🤞 Can you name an integration that is "like it should be" from your view and roughly from a similar architecture (rest API, a component with multiple platforms, nothing special.)? It feels like there are XX implementations in use for the same results and would be cool to have a "reference integration" :D maybe this would be a nice thing in general, not only for me in this case here...

> Additionally, a lot of ignores for typing and pylint. In general, those should be rare, but quite common in this PR. I guess in most places the ignore/disable comment isn't even needed.

Yo, I will check them...

> Lastly, I think this integration would really benefit from implementing the DataUpdateCoordinator, which would reduce a lot of complexity in general.

agreed... but would you advice to do this also in this PR as its a little crazy here anyways? or afterwards in a separate one?


Thanks again! Will check your comments and come back to you then :)
I would suggest that we first add support for DataUpdateCoordinator (in a separate pr). Then this pr will also be smaller and less complex.

if you are still unsatisfied in general, please do not review but close ✌️ (I dont mean some small style or convention issues which can be fixed in minutes, that's no problem!)

Then this looks good to me 👍

Could you make sure all changes are intentional? (I do not think they are)
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/53399/files

Have you tested this locally? (It does not seem so)
shouldn’t we just merge [sureha](https://github.com/benleb/sureha)?^^ It’s even using the DataUpdateCoordinator now…
Should be possible if you can break it up into smaller pull requests and it follows the standard of Home Assistant core.
None of the other pull requests add Feeder & FeederBowl sensors, so it would be great if you want to add that.
ah sorry, maybe that was a little misleading :D I will look at that if your stuff is merged :)

issue_context.title: SurePet integration not updating
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After the last update 2021.5 the SurePet integration is working again but is not polling and updating the status.
Only after restarting the core, the correct status is polled and shown.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.5.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sure Petcare

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/surepetcare/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
# Sure Pet cat door
surepetcare:
  username: REDACTED
  password: REDACTED
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
